name: command_session
description: Control a persistent command session started by `execute_command` with `yield_time_ms`. action=poll waits for new output, action=write sends stdin then waits, and action=close terminates the process. Each poll is one full model round, so poll only when the process needs to be supervised. Session ids are scoped to the agent session that created them. Output is captured raw from the child, so `| tail` and `| grep` hold everything back until the process exits, so every poll reports no new output until then, and `| head` ends the pipeline early.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later command_session calls in this turn:
- Reuse the exact `session_id` printed as `[session ...]` by `execute_command`; never invent or reuse an id from another session.
- An id can refer to a process that already exited but still has buffered output to read; one poll drains it. A session that exited and drained its output is removed automatically, and a later poll reports an unknown session.
- Polling is deliberately slow: each poll waits 5000-60000ms (default 30000) and costs a full model round. Do not poll in a tight loop, and do not add `sleep` to wait for output. If the command is finite, let `execute_command` block instead of starting a session.

action.description: Required operation: `poll` waits for new output, `write` sends `write_stdin` then waits, `close` terminates the session.

session_id.description: Required id returned by `execute_command` when the process is still running or has buffered output left to read.

write_stdin.description: Bytes written verbatim to the session's stdin. Required for action=write; a non-empty value is rejected for action=poll/close, while an empty string is treated as omitted. Include a trailing newline for line-oriented prompts. For sessions started with `execute_command` `pty=true`, EOF is not implied by ending the write: send `\u0004` (Ctrl-D) if the program waits for EOF. Do not send secrets; the text becomes part of the tool call history.

yield_time_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for new output after polling or writing (5000-60000, default 30000). Ignored by action=close.
